text:
morgan: quick brainstorm thread: designing audit-friendly labels for automatic fallback policies. goal: make each fallback decision trivially explainable in the console and via API.
arya: love it. ops asked for "reason granularity": should we store both coarse reason (latency/error/quota) and fine reason (p95_latency=1700, backend_error=502, quota_burst).
devin: yes both. the UI should surface coarse reason for quick scans and allow expanding to see fine reason & metrics.
srinivas: API plan: include header `X-Redwood-Fallback: reason=latency;detail=p95>1500;mode=lite` and telemetry fields `fallback_reason` and `fallback_detail` for logs.
morgan: retention: by default keep 30d. small sampled payloads (max 512 chars) for audit. enterprise can opt into 365d.
arya: on rollouts page we should render fallback variants inline with the main model. add a tiny "why" pill next to variant that opens a lightbox with an example from audit samples.
devin: QA ask: need a view to compare primary vs fallback outputs side-by-side for sampled requests and a small quality delta metric (e.g., rouge/sim).
srinivas: billing: normalized units for fallback + raw underlying charge breakdown. console shows normalized cost and a link to raw charges.
morgan: i'm going to sketch the header + telemetry samples and push a short doc in the draft PR. can we review this afternoon?
